title: B+A · Bowl Park + Street Corner
pitch: Round 2: variant B's sunken bowls, snake run and full pipe, plus A's street corner on the east side: a terrace with a stair set and handrails, a hubba and a bank, the pergola and the ring sculpture.
facts: Most features sit below the deck: from a landed Quad the Map looks almost flat.
Heightfield transitions at 20–25 cm resolution: the vertical bowl walls show as steep slopes.
The street corner adds what stands above head height, besides the poles: terrace, pergola, ring.

features.name: Pool bowl
features.desc: 16 × 10 m, shallow end 1.8 m deep (west) to deep end 3.2 m (east), 0.6 m of vertical wall, steel coping.

features.name: Cradle bowl
features.desc: Round, 10 m across, 1.9 m deep, all transition.

features.name: Snake run
features.desc: About 55 m long and 4.4 m wide, winding, up to 1.5 m deep; ramps in at both ends.

features.name: Full pipe
features.desc: A concrete tube 3.6 m across inside, 7 m long: fly straight through.

features.name: Stair set and handrails
features.desc: 6 steps up to a +1.2 m terrace, two handrails 0.9 m above the steps.

features.name: Hubba and bank
features.desc: A sloped ledge beside the stairs; a 3.6 m bank up to the terrace.

features.name: Pergola
features.desc: 10 × 6 m. Slats at 3.6 m with 0.6 m gaps (a whoop gap, a tight 5" gap); 3.3 m clear underneath.

features.name: Ring sculpture
features.desc: A steel ring with a 3.1 m opening, centre at 2.2 m, flown east-west.

features.name: Pyramid
features.desc: Four-sided hip, 1 m high, in the middle of the deck.

features.name: Shade shelter
features.desc: 8 × 4 m roof at 3 m on four posts.

features.name: Light poles
features.desc: 9 m poles on the corners and the long sides.

spots.note: Deck between the two bowls, facing into the pool bowl's deep end.
